message.content: 抱歉，我目前无法实时查询外部市场数据。若您想了解最新的比特币价格，建议查看可靠的金融资讯网站（如 CoinMarketCap、CoinGecko、Binance 等）或使用相关的 API。若您有其他关于比特币或加密货币的问题，我很乐意为您解答！
message.reasoning: User asks: "目前比特幣價格是多少？" (What is the current Bitcoin price?). We need to provide the current price. We can use the function to retrieve data from a database. But we don't have a database. We could use an external API. But we only have the function to retrieve from a database. We might not have a database with Bitcoin prices. We could respond that we don't have real-time data. But we can approximate or say we can't fetch. The user wants the current price. We can say we don't have real-time data. Or we can use a placeholder. The best approach: explain that we don't have real-time data. Or we can use a known API. But we don't have a function for that. So we should respond that we cannot fetch real-time data.
